story_room.name: Story/theme room

agents.claim: The route works when zodiac labels become repeated action receipts.
agents.recommendation: Protect the exact creator copy and make Zuv active.

agents.objection: Blocked unless every slide is staged behavior.
agents.recommendation: Use objects, hands, eye-line, and consequence as proof.

story_room.summary: The room selects the planner/spontaneous complement route and rejects pure zodiac quote cards.
debate_records: Repair by making Zuv active in every slide.

exploration_routes.name: 5-Year Plan Meets Already Left
exploration_routes.story_lens: Banter to belonging through opposite tempos.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: One partner plans the future while the other starts it.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: Their ways of moving through life look mismatched until the scenes prove they are complementary.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu initiates, books, edits, argues aloud, laughs in motion, points toward the road, and dances in balcony lights.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv plans, worries, steadies, repairs small details, follows, and visibly loves the chaos.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: calendar, chai, keys, cafe booking, checklist heart/arrow, soft disagreement, bracelet/sleeve fix, screenshots, road lights, closed notebook
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The calm is not resistance; it is his way of holding space for her spark.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Zodiac and planner/spontaneous couples can instantly tag each other.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu repeatedly initiates visible movement: keys, booking, red-arrow edit, expressive fight, road-pointing, dancing.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Zuv repeatedly responds: looks up from calendar, explains, notices the edit, softens in disagreement, fixes a sleeve/bracelet, follows the road-point, watches with fondness.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eye-lines move from planning objects to each other; Zuv repeatedly chooses her over the plan.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Keys pull, phone books, checklist changes, arms fold then soften, bracelet/sleeve is fixed, screenshots are held, keys rest beside the closed notebook.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Slide 4 and slide 8 carry the quiet: his silent worry, then the settled closed-notebook pause.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The contrast stops being incompatibility and becomes a relay: his stability lets her spark move safely, her spark makes his plan alive.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: He acts calm, but he loves the chaos; somehow, they make perfect sense.
